name: Fitts's Law
axiom: Target acquisition time is a function of distance and target bounding width.
trigger: Users miss small controls or take long pointer trips for frequent actions, especially on touch screens.

checklist.text: Make touch targets at least 44 x 44 px, or 24 x 24 px with adequate spacing.
Pin frequent primary controls to screen edges or corners on desktop.
Place contextual actions next to the initiating click point.

antiPattern.violation: Mobile checkout puts a 12 x 12 px Confirm Order text link in the extreme top-right corner.
antiPattern.remediation: Use a full-width sticky footer button at least 48 px tall within thumb reach.

academicOrigin.title: The Information Capacity of the Human Motor System in Controlling the Amplitude of Movement
